description: build_screen/2 becomes Components.Screen.render/3, returning a VFlow of [Header, Resources, Transcript, Loader, PendingMessages, Input, InputDropdown, Notification, Footer]. Custom widgets ({from, %{render: fn w → lines end}}) become regular VHoles wrapping the factory's output as VLines. The render_dialog_overlay/3 path also collapses into the tree. Tests: existing interactive flow tests stay green; the [""] prefix that today opens build_screen is emitted by Screen as a VFlow gap.
title: Replace Interactive.build_screen/2 with a single root component
